name: Alarm
description: You ward a door, window, or 20-foot cube for 8 hours. When a creature you have not designated enters the area, the spell alerts you with a mental ping if you are awake, or a ringing bell if you are asleep.

name: Animal Friendship
description: A beast with low Intelligence makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 24 hours. If you or your allies harm it, the spell ends; upcasting lets you befriend one additional beast per level.

name: Armor of Agathys
description: Spectral frost armors you: you gain 5 temporary hit points, and while any of them remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage. Both amounts rise by 5 per slot level above 1st.

name: Arms of Hadar
description: Shadowy tendrils erupt from you in every direction. Each other creature within 10 feet makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage and losing its reaction on a failure, or half damage on a success.

name: Bane
description: Up to three creatures make Charisma saves; each that fails subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws for the duration. Upcasting adds one more target per level.

name: Bless
description: You bless up to three creatures. Whenever a blessed creature makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it adds 1d4 to the roll. Upcasting adds one more target per level.

name: Burning Hands
description: A sheet of flame roars from your outstretched fingers. Each creature in the 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success, and unattended flammables ignite.

name: Charm Person
description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save (with advantage if you are fighting it) or is charmed for an hour, regarding you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends it knows it was charmed; upcasting targets one more humanoid per level.

name: Color Spray
description: A dazzling array of flashing color sprays from your hand. Every creature in the 15-foot cone simply makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Command
description: You speak a one-word command — Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt — to a creature that makes a Wisdom save or obeys on its next turn. Upcasting commands one additional creature per level.

name: Comprehend Languages
description: For an hour you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear and can read any written language you touch, though decoding secret writing and ciphers is beyond it.

name: Create or Destroy Water
description: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water (as rain in a 30-foot cube, or in an open container) or destroy up to 10 gallons, and can also disperse fog in the area. The volume doubles with each higher slot.

name: Cure Wounds
description: Your touch closes wounds: a creature regains 2d8 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier, and 2d8 more for each slot level above 1st.

name: Detect Evil and Good
description: While you concentrate you sense whether any aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead is within 30 feet, and whether any object or place nearby has been consecrated or desecrated, though cover can block the sense.

name: Detect Magic
description: You sense the presence of magic within 30 feet; using an action while it lasts, you can see a faint aura around any creature or object bearing magic and learn its school. Thin barriers block it, and it is often cast as a ritual.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: You sense the presence and kind of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet while you concentrate, though solid barriers block the sense.

name: Disguise Self
description: You make yourself — clothes, armor, and gear included — look like someone else of roughly your build for an hour. The disguise is visual only: it fails to touch, and a suspicious creature can pierce it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: A discordant melody only one creature can hear wracks it with pain: Wisdom save or 3d6 psychic damage and it must immediately use its reaction to flee from you; on a success it takes half damage and does not flee.

name: Divine Favor
description: Your weapon strikes are blessed for a minute, dealing an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit. No concentration required.

name: Entangle
description: Grasping weeds and vines fill a 20-foot square, making it difficult terrain. Creatures in the area make Strength saves or are restrained until they break free with a Strength check as an action.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: Magic lends speed to your heels: when you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns while you concentrate, you can take the Dash action.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Objects and creatures in a 20-foot cube are outlined in colored light. Creatures that fail a Dexterity save shed dim light for the duration, and attacks against outlined creatures have advantage if the attacker can see them.

name: False Life
description: A necromantic facsimile of life bolsters you: you gain 2d4 + 4 temporary hit points, plus 5 more for each slot level above 1st.

name: Feather Fall
description: Cast in reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet falls: up to five falling creatures descend at a gentle 60 feet per round and land on their feet unharmed.

name: Find Familiar
description: You gain the service of a familiar — a celestial, fey, or fiend spirit in the form of a small animal such as a bat, cat, owl, or toad. It acts independently but obeys you, cannot attack, and you can see through its eyes and deliver touch spells through it.

name: Fog Cloud
description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of fog billows out, heavily obscuring its area until a strong wind disperses it. Its radius grows by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Goodberry
description: Ten magical berries appear in your hand, fresh for 24 hours. Eating one restores 1 hit point and nourishes the creature for a full day.

name: Grease
description: Slick grease coats a 10-foot square (it is not flammable). Creatures in the area, and any that enter or end their turn there, make Dexterity saves or fall prone.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of divine light: ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage, and the target shimmers with mystical light so the next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

name: Healing Word
description: A word of comfort knits wounds at range: one creature regains 2d4 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier — leaving your action free, and gains 2d4 more per higher slot.

name: Hellish Rebuke
description: Cast in reaction to being damaged: you point at the creature that hurt you and it is momentarily engulfed in hellish flame, making a Dexterity save or taking 2d10 fire damage (half on a success). Each higher slot adds 1d10.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature is flooded with courage: it is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of its turns while you concentrate.

name: Hex
description: You curse a creature: your attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to it, and it has disadvantage on ability checks with one ability you choose. If it dies, you can move the curse to a new creature; the duration stretches to 8 or 24 hours in higher slots.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You mark a creature as your quarry: your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage to it, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it. If it falls, you can move the mark to a new creature with a bonus action.

name: Identify
description: Handling an item or creature throughout the casting, you learn its magical properties, how to use them, whether it requires attunement, and how many charges it holds; on a creature you learn which spells are affecting it.

name: Illusory Script
description: You write a message that appears as entirely different writing to everyone except creatures you designate. Others see whatever innocent text you choose; truesight pierces the deception.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: Your touch channels necrotic energy into a creature, which makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

name: Jump
description: As a bonus action you touch a creature and, once on each of its turns for a minute, it can jump up to 30 feet by spending only 10 feet of movement.

name: Longstrider
description: You touch a creature and quicken it: its speed increases by 10 feet for an hour. Each higher slot quickens one additional creature.

name: Mage Armor
description: A protective force surrounds a willing creature that is not wearing armor: its base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier for 8 hours, ending early if it dons armor.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three glowing darts of force strike creatures of your choice, unerringly, each dealing 1d4 + 1 force damage (3d4 + 3 total if all strike one target). Each higher slot creates one additional dart.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
description: One willing creature is warded against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead: such creatures attack it at disadvantage, and it cannot be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them.

name: Purify Food and Drink
description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere is purified, rendered free of poison and disease — a ritual that makes suspect rations safe.

name: Sanctuary
description: You ward a creature for a minute: any attacker must make a Wisdom save or choose a new target (or lose the attack). The ward ends for a creature that attacks, casts a harmful spell, or deals damage.

name: Searing Smite
description: Cast as you hit with a weapon: the strike deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and ignites the target, which takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it makes a Constitution save (or is doused) to end the flames. Both rolls rise 1d6 per higher slot.

name: Shield
description: Cast in reaction to being hit or targeted by Magic Missile: an invisible barrier gives you +5 AC until the start of your next turn — including against the triggering attack — and Magic Missile deals you no damage.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A shimmering field protects one creature you choose, granting it a +2 bonus to AC while you concentrate, for up to 10 minutes.

name: Silent Image
description: You create the image of an object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot cube, and can move it with your action while it stays in range. It has no sound, smell, or substance; interaction or an Investigation check reveals it.

name: Sleep
description: Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere makes a Wisdom save or is incapacitated, and repeats the save at the end of its next turn, falling unconscious for the duration on a second failure. Damage or a slap wakes a sleeper early.

name: Speak with Animals
description: For 10 minutes you can comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts, learning what they have seen and enlisting simple favors — what they tell you is limited by their intelligence and senses.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
description: A creature perceives everything as hilariously funny and collapses: Wisdom save or it falls prone and is incapacitated by laughter, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with advantage).

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
description: A circular plane of force, 3 feet across, hovers just off the ground and follows you at a distance, carrying up to 500 pounds of cargo like the most loyal of porters. It cannot cross drops deeper than 10 feet.

name: Thunderous Smite
description: Cast as you hit with a melee weapon: the strike rings like a thunderclap, dealing an extra 2d6 thunder damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you, audible 300 feet away. Each other creature in a 15-foot cube makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure, or half damage on a success.

name: Unseen Servant
description: An invisible, mindless force performs simple tasks at your command for an hour — fetching, cleaning, serving, opening unstuck doors — with the strength of a frail servant, ending if it takes any real punishment.

name: Witch Bolt
description: A beam of crackling energy tethers you to a target on a ranged spell attack hit for 2d12 lightning damage, and you can use a bonus action on later turns to deal 1d12 lightning damage automatically. Each higher slot adds 1d12 to the initial damage.

name: Wrathful Smite
description: Cast as a bonus action immediately after you hit a creature with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike: the target takes an extra 1d6 necrotic damage and must succeed on a Wisdom save or have the Frightened condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Frightened target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. Each higher slot adds 1d6.
